==Description==
'''Scary Coffin''' is an emote obtained from the [[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Battle Pass]]. It was made by Mewious, AMGMX and SoupedGun. The emote is not looped though it ends only when interacted by the player. It has no music and it cannot be moved. This emote can be interacted with, making the player jump out of the coffin, performing a jumpscare.

This emote could be obtained at Level 20 of the premium track, where it costed {{CandyCorns|630 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|70}} ({{Robux|52}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale) to unlock. It had a total cost of {{CandyCorns|6,090 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|1,420}} ({{Robux|1,070}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale).
